purpose: Define certification validation lifecycle where first validation is online against authoritative registry evidence and successful results may then be cached locally with explicit freshness/expiry semantics.

owns: Certification First Validation and Cache semantics

value.first_rule: First validation of an unseen certification/package pair is performed online against the authoritative registry/service.
value.cache_rule: Successful validation result may be cached locally.
value.cache_key_rule: Cache key binds certification identity plus exact package/hash subject.
value.offline_rule: Offline use may rely on a still-valid cached result according to policy.
value.revocation_rule: Online revalidation can observe revocation/supersession/expiry and invalidate cached acceptance.
value.failure_rule: No prior valid cache plus unavailable online validation results in explicit unverifiable state rather than silent pass.

invariants.rule: Certification is explicit technical evidence bound to an exact package/artifact snapshot; commercial payment, license status or runtime authorization never substitute for certification evidence.

hard_gates.condition: first-ever validation passes offline without evidence
expired cache treated as indefinitely valid
unavailable registry silently treated as valid
